name: EMA20 Pullback in Uptrend v1
description: New signal family: buy when price pulls back to the rising 20-EMA inside an EMA50 uptrend and bounces on above-average delivery. Entry fires when previous close was at/below EMA20 (within 1%) and today's close reclaims above it — the 'knots and swing pullbacks' setup from Bulkowski Ch.1 and Grimes Ch.3/6 (program.md idea #9). Sharper than pullback_trend_v1's generic EMA cross (which fired 13k times); the EMA50 above-close gate and EMA20-touch restriction should reduce trade count 10x.
